retrievalProfile.description: A multi-subject ensemble portrait featuring vignetted faces with prominent 1970s hairstyles arranged in a circular composition against a textured, monochromatic blue-grey background.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast color photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A collage of six individual portraits arranged in a loose ring, unified by a heavy grain texture and a desaturated blue-grey color cast. The subjects feature large afro hairstyles that blend into the dark, vignetted edges of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular arrangement of subjects around a central negative space
High-contrast lighting on faces against dark hair and backgrounds
Uniform monochromatic tint across all elements
Heavy surface distressing and paper-like grain
coreInvariants: Soft-edged vignetting on all individual portraits
Prominent 1970s-era hairstyles as a framing element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six subjects of roughly equal scale arranged in a hexagonal or circular pattern around the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical axis where the title and a small heart icon are placed.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the ring of faces clockwise, starting from the top left, eventually settling on the central typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A central void and the outer corners are filled with a textured, hazy blue-grey atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated steel blue background and mid-tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal black for hair and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white for facial highlights and typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between skin highlights and dark hair.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numeral II centered below the main text
Small heart icon used as a decorative separator
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying scales and decorative icons.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif look of the era.
Provides the necessary elegance and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic blue-grey textured background with six vignetted portraits of people with large 70s hairstyles arranged in a circle, leaving the top center empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase serif text in the top middle negative space, including a Roman numeral and a small heart icon below it.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue-grey?
Are the portraits vignetted so they blend into the background?
Is the typography centered and serif-based?
Is there a visible paper grain or distressed texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for circular flow of subjects
Ensure text is legible against the textured background
Confirm the presence of 70s-style hair volume
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble Portrait + 70s Soul Aesthetic + Monochromatic Blue Tint + Vignetted Circular Layout
